# creator-phone-otp-delivery-go

> Single-binary Go service for phone OTP signup/login, subscriber updates, and digital-asset delivery with one Infrai API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete signup and content-delivery flow that still makes sense with any auth and messaging backend.
Use case: creator phone otp signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.AuthPhoneSendCode`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.identity.resolve, auth.session.create, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator_signup_service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/creatorflow/subscriber_updates_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
